coldBucketInterval.description:
Interval by which columns are aggregated to be stored in cold store. Has to be equal to or higher than {@link TimedDataFields#bucketInterval}
If not set, system will default to one interval coarser than {@link TimedDataFields#bucketInterval}

maxHotBucketDate.description: Max value across all the buckets in hot storage. E.g. max date until which data should be in hot storage (e.g. "now() - period(6, 'MONTH')"

title: Describes partitioning strategy for NormalizedTimeseries tables indicating how much data lives in what storage
name: NormalizationPartitionStrategy
